title: Data editor
description: Browse and edit table rows, and issue API keys for your applications.
selectPrompt: Enter a database and a table to begin.
selectPromptDescription: The editor loads rows and API keys once you provide both.
workspaceDescription: Select a workspace to edit data.
workspaceDenied: This organization has no workspaces yet. Ask an organization or workspace owner or administrator to create the first one.
workspaceLoadingDescription: Fetching the workspaces available to the active organization.
filtersDescription: Narrow the rows with conditions on a column.
rowsDescription: Rows of the selected table, paged by cursor.
rowsEmptyDescription: Insert a row with the insert form.
rowsShown: {count, plural, one {# row on this page} other {# rows on this page}}
editDescription: Change the row JSON. The id primary key is not sent among the changes.
insertDescription: Write the new row as a JSON object.
missingKeyEdit: The row has no "id" primary key to edit it
missingKeyDelete: The row has no "id" primary key to delete it
mutationErrorTitle: The action could not be completed
deleteDescription: This action permanently deletes the row.
revokeDescription: This action permanently revokes the key.
revokeConsequenceKey: Applications that use key {prefix} can no longer access the data.
revokeConsequenceUndo: A revoked key cannot be reactivated; you can only issue a new one.
keysDescription: Issue anon or service keys for the active workspace.
keysEmpty: There are no API keys yet.
keysEmptyDescription: Issue an anon or service key to get started.
revealDescription: The key is shown only once. It is discarded when you close this dialog.
shownOnce: Copy this key now; it will not be shown again:
previewTableLabel: Preview rows fetched with the issued key
serverError: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
networkError: Could not reach the server. Try again.
rowsError: The rows could not be loaded.
keysError: The API keys could not be loaded.
noAccessDescription: You do not have permission to view this resource.
notFoundDescription: The database, schema or table you entered does not exist. Go back and check the names.
